request: Build a small Jac project tracker. Let people create root projects, add sub-projects and tasks, browse the hierarchy, approve draft children, and delete a task or project. Show the current projects on a simple home page with a clear empty state. Preserve project-to-project and project-to-task graph relationships. The core project and task operations should also be available as public Jac functions so they can be tested without a browser. Keep the app usable without an AI key.
acceptance: Creating a root project and a sub-project makes the child discoverable under its parent and by ID.
Creating a task under a sub-project makes it discoverable through that project.
Approving a draft task or project clears is_draft, and deleting a task or project removes it from traversal.
The home page allows creating and viewing a root project and gives clear empty, loading, and error states.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and inferred client/server placement.
Do not require an external AI provider; this is a deterministic slice of the source application's project hierarchy.
Keep a single source repository for this trajectory: Rui/pm.
